line: RULES CHANGED: rooms/{CODE}/pt (new — THE TREE CAP: the room's stamped-tree counter, 1,000 a room) + rooms/{CODE}/jw/{matchId}/t0 + rooms/{CODE}/hr/{matchId}/t0 (the stamp only WITH the counter) — THE CONSOLE FIX — RE-PUBLISH database.rules.json in the Firebase console (Downloads\NEON\database.rules.nov20-console.json), any time AFTER the deploy is live: the new code works on the old rules (its plain stamp is the fallback), a phone still on the old code works on the new ones (GO without a stamp until Nov 27)
